descriptionAdvanced.de: Middlesbrough liegt am Südufer des Flusses Tees in North Yorkshire und ist untrennbar mit der Geschichte der britischen Eisen- und Stahlindustrie verbunden. Nach der Entdeckung von Eisenerz in den Cleveland Hills im Jahr 1850 wandelte sich der Ort in rasantem Tempo von einem kleinen Gehöft zu einer bedeutenden Industriestadt, die oft als 'Ironopolis' bezeichnet wurde. Ein herausragendes architektonisches Denkmal ist die Middlesbrough Transporter Bridge aus dem Jahr 1911, eine der seltensten Brückenkonstruktionen der Welt. Die Stadt ist zudem der Geburtsort des Entdeckers Captain James Cook, dem im Vorort Marton ein Museum gewidmet ist. In der modernen Ära hat sich Middlesbrough zu einem Zentrum für digitale Medien und Bildung entwickelt, wobei die Teesside University eine zentrale Rolle spielt. Die Lage zwischen der Nordsee und dem North York Moors Nationalpark bietet zudem attraktive Freizeitmöglichkeiten in der Natur.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Middlesbrough a Tees folyó déli partján, North Yorkshire megyében található, és elválaszthatatlan a brit vas- és acélipar történetétől. Miután 1850-ben vasércet fedeztek fel a Cleveland Hills dombjain, a település rendkívüli sebességgel fejlődött apró tanyából jelentős iparvárossá, amelyet gyakran 'Ironopolis' néven emlegettek. Kiemelkedő építészeti emléke az 1911-ben átadott Middlesbrough Transporter Bridge, amely a világ egyik legritkább hídszerkezete. A város emellett James Cook kapitány, a híres felfedező szülőhelye, akinek tiszteletére Marton negyedben múzeumot alapítottak. A modern korszakban Middlesbrough a digitális média és az oktatás központjává vált, ahol a Teesside Egyetem meghatározó szerepet tölt be. Az Északi-tenger és a North York Moors Nemzeti Park közelsége vonzó szabadidős lehetőségeket kínál.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Middlesbrough este situat pe malul sudic al râului Tees în North Yorkshire, fiind indisolubil legat de istoria industriei siderurgice britanice. După descoperirea minereului de fier în dealurile Cleveland în 1850, localitatea s-a transformat cu o viteză uluitoare dintr-o mică fermă într-un centru industrial major, supranumit 'Ironopolis'. Un monument arhitectural rar este Podul Transbordor Middlesbrough, inaugurat în 1911, care rămâne unul dintre puținele de acest tip din lume. Orașul este, de asemenea, locul de naștere al celebrului explorator Captain James Cook, celebrat printr-un muzeu în Marton. În epoca modernă, Middlesbrough s-a orientat către media digitală și educație, Universitatea Teesside fiind un pilon central. Locația sa între Marea Nordului și Parcul Național North York Moors oferă acces facil la peisaje naturale spectaculoase.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Middlesbrough is located on the south bank of the River Tees in North Yorkshire, intrinsically linked to the history of the British iron and steel industry. Following the discovery of ironstone in the Cleveland Hills in 1850, the settlement grew at an extraordinary pace, evolving from a small farmstead into a major industrial center nicknamed 'Ironopolis'. Its most famous engineering landmark is the Middlesbrough Transporter Bridge, completed in 1911, which is one of the few remaining operational examples of its kind in the world. The town is also the birthplace of the legendary explorer Captain James Cook, commemorated by a dedicated museum in his home suburb of Marton. In the modern era, Middlesbrough has repositioned itself as a hub for digital media and higher education, centered around Teesside University, while benefiting from its proximity to the North York Moors.
descriptionAdvanced.es: Middlesbrough es una ciudad en North Yorkshire, Inglaterra, situada en la orilla sur del río Tees. Se desarrolló en el siglo XIX como centro de la industria del hierro y el acero. El Middlesbrough Transporter Bridge (1911) es un hito icónico. La ciudad tiene unos 140.000 habitantes. La Universidad de Teesside tiene su campus principal aquí. La economía pasó de la industria pesada a los servicios y la tecnología. El Middlesbrough Football Club juega en el Riverside Stadium. El mima (Instituto de Arte Moderno de Middlesbrough) es un centro cultural.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: Middlesbrough é uma cidade em North Yorkshire, Inglaterra, situada na margem sul do rio Tees. Desenvolveu-se no século XIX como centro da indústria siderúrgica. A Ponte Transporter de Middlesbrough (1911) é um marco icónico. A cidade tem cerca de 140.000 habitantes. A Universidade de Teesside tem o seu campus principal aqui. A economia mudou da indústria pesada para serviços e tecnologia. O Middlesbrough Football Club joga no Riverside Stadium. O mima (Instituto de Arte Moderna de Middlesbrough) é um centro cultural.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Middlesbrough est une ville du North Yorkshire, en Angleterre, située sur la rive sud de la rivière Tees. Elle s'est développée au XIXe siècle comme centre de l'industrie sidérurgique. Le pont transbordeur de Middlesbrough (1911) est un monument emblématique. La ville compte environ 140 000 habitants. L'Université de Teesside y a son campus principal. L'économie est passée de l'industrie lourde aux services et à la technologie. Le Middlesbrough Football Club joue au Riverside Stadium. Le mima (Institut d'art moderne de Middlesbrough) est un centre culturel.

en: Middlesbrough was famously known as 'Ironopolis' in the 19th century.
The Transporter Bridge across the Tees was opened in 1911.
Explorer Captain James Cook was born in Marton in 1728.
Ironstone was discovered in the nearby Cleveland Hills in 1850.
Teesside University was granted university status in 1992.
Middlesbrough Football Club was established in 1876.
